## [1.2.0-dev.15](https://github.com/SapitoSucio/FroggoMorphePatches/compare/v1.2.0-dev.14...v1.2.0-dev.15) (2026-08-28)

### ✨ New Features

* **facebook:** trace story notify exceptions ([980c5af](https://github.com/SapitoSucio/FroggoMorphePatches/commit/980c5af4e2cb9ecafe83445351457c925eb0929b))

patches.name: [Diag A1] Facebook 573 ads - CSR tail-load
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: only disables MainFeedCSRDataLoaderImpl async-ad tail-load dispatch.

patches.name: [Diag A2] Facebook 573 ads - CSR converter
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: only nulls the bZU Feed CSR response converter.

patches.name: [Diag A3] Facebook 573 ads - Async controller
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: only replaces FeedAsyncAdsController output with an empty C6Ke.

patches.name: [Diag B] Facebook 573 ads - Final feed filter
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: only filters SPONSORED/PROMOTION feed edges and MultiAds sponsored data.

patches.name: [Diag C] Facebook 573 ads - Reels/video
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: only disables Reels/video and commercial-break ad fetch/success paths.

patches.name: [Diag D] Facebook 573 Stories - publication lifecycle
patches.description: DEV diagnostic: logs Story bucket publication, cached replay and viewer notification without changing behavior.

patches.name: Block Facebook ads (573)
patches.description: Stops feed, Reels/video, and commercial-break ads without modifying the Story viewer pipeline.

patches.name: Block Facebook automatic refresh (573)
patches.description: Suppresses lifecycle feed refresh while preserving explicit refresh paths.

patches.name: Block Facebook Story ads (573)
patches.description: Pre-release experiment: filters Story ad buckets only at the concrete X68 provider return boundary.
